title: promote-computer-image workflow cannot be dispatched until it exists on main
description: The promote-computer-image workflow file is not on main (the default branch), so workflow_dispatch cannot run it. The manual script infra/promote-computer-image-development.sh is the working path until the next release promotes develop to main.
right_now_summary: The workflow is not on main yet, so use the manual promotion script until the next release.
